_comment: Entirely fictional. One persona; every domain is *.example; the phone numbers are in the reserved 555-01xx range. Safe to commit and to store on a real account (the run forgets everything it wrote).

learnings.text: Jordan prefers meeting summaries as three bullet points, never prose.
Jordan's sister Priya Raman lives in Pune and visits every Diwali.
To file an expense, Jordan exports the receipt as PDF and emails it to expenses@northwind.example.
Jordan's manager is Dana Whitfield, not Dana Whitman.
Jordan keeps a running list of book recommendations in a note titled Reading Queue.

brain_doc.title: Northwind travel policy (fictional)
brain_doc.text: Northwind Travel Policy. Economy class for flights under 6 hours. Hotel cap is 180 EUR per night in Berlin and 140 EUR elsewhere in Germany. Per diem is 45 EUR. Bookings go through travel@northwind.example at least 14 days ahead.
